label: IV print out of line with VIX
detail: IBKR's SPY implied vol prints 0.257 and 0.262 on 9-10 February while the VIX closed at 17.4 and 17.8. On other 2026 days the IBKR series runs about 3 points below the VIX; here it is 8 points above, so these two bars are treated as a data anomaly, not a market move.

label: War begins
detail: US and Israeli strikes on Iran. Iran declares the Strait of Hormuz closed to hostile shipping, and cross-strait traffic is largely halted until 7 April.

label: Ras Laffan drone strike
detail: Iranian drones strike Qatar's Ras Laffan complex and QatarEnergy halts LNG production.

label: Tanker rates at a record
detail: Average VLCC earnings reach a record of about $387,000 a day in the week to 6 March (Clarksons), as Gulf shipping is disrupted.

label: Ras Laffan missile strikes
detail: Missile strikes on 18-19 March damage two LNG trains at Ras Laffan, taking out about 17% of Qatar's LNG capacity for three to five years.

label: Two-week ceasefire
detail: A two-week ceasefire is agreed and cross-strait traffic begins to resume.

label: US naval blockade
detail: The US imposes a naval blockade on Iran after the Islamabad talks fail.

label: Agreement announced (MoU first mentioned)
detail: The US and Iran announce an agreement to end the war and reopen the strait.

label: Islamabad Memorandum signed
detail: A 14-point memorandum of understanding is signed, opening a 60-day period to negotiate final terms, including an end to the naval blockade.

label: MoU breaks down
detail: Strikes resume ten days after signing and the US declares the agreement over on 7 July; the interim ceasefire collapses on 8 July.

label: Attacks on merchant ships
detail: Renewed attacks on merchant ships in the Strait of Hormuz accompany the collapse of the ceasefire.

label: Diesel crack above $100/bbl
detail: US diesel crack spreads, which first passed $100 a barrel in late August, reach a record above $106 a barrel.

label: Tanker rates at a new record
detail: Global tanker rates reach record levels as Hormuz disruption tightens supply (Bloomberg).

label: East-West pipeline struck
detail: A strike on Saudi Arabia's East-West crude pipeline, the main route around Hormuz, leads Saudi Arabia to shut the line.

label: IV print out of line with VIX
detail: IBKR's SPY implied vol prints 0.244 on 17 August while the VIX closed at 15.2, and the series returns to 0.125 the next day. On other 2026 days the IBKR series runs about 3 points below the VIX, so this bar is treated as a data anomaly, not a market move.
